_comment: Copy this to mcp_servers.json (gitignored) to give the FREE experimenter one or more MCP connectors. The map is exactly the SDK's mcp_servers argument: {"<name>": <McpServerConfig>}. Each configured server's tools are permitted to the free agent as mcp__<name>; the capability guard still vets every call, so a connector can never reach memory/, runs/, or credentials. Remove this file (or leave only mcp_servers.example.json) to run with no connectors — the default, byte-identical path.
